# TC-PRF-010-03: Manual override of an auto-generated recommendation -> mandatory justification enforced (client + server)

## 1. Test Objective
Verify FR-3: HR can manually override an auto-generated recommendation (change its type, amount, target grade, etc.), and the override REQUIRES a mandatory justification comment. The override is rejected client-side AND server-side if the justification is missing/blank. This protects the audit trail for deviations from the rule-based suggestion.

## 2. Related Requirements
- User Story: US-PRF-010
- Acceptance Criteria: AC-2 (override of an auto-generated suggestion)
- Functional Requirements: FR-3 (manual override with mandatory justification)
- Data Requirements: S7 (recommendations.justification not null on override)

## 3. Preconditions
- Tenant "acme"; HR Officer Pat Ng authenticated with `Performance.Publish.All`.
- An auto-generated Draft suggestion exists for Emp C from TC-PRF-010-02 (auto type = Bonus, amount $2,000).

## 4. Test Data
| Field | Value | Notes |
|-------|-------|-------|
| Original (auto) | Bonus $2,000 | rule-generated |
| Override to | Increment 5% | manual change |
| Justification (valid) | "Base-pay below band midpoint; increment fits better than a one-off bonus." | required |
| Justification (invalid) | "" / whitespace | must be rejected |

## 5. Test Steps
| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | As Pat, open Emp C's auto-generated Bonus suggestion and change the type to Increment 5% | The inline editor surfaces a REQUIRED justification field for the override (FR-3); Save is disabled while it is empty (client-side gate). |
| 2 | Attempt to save with the justification blank (bypassing the UI, e.g. direct `PUT .../recommendations/{id}` with no justification) | Server returns 400 with a validation error -- the override is rejected because justification is mandatory (FR-3). No change persists. |
| 3 | Enter the valid justification; Save | The override persists: type = Increment 5%, justification recorded, status stays Draft (override does not auto-submit). |
| 4 | Inspect the record | The recommendation shows the manual override + justification + an indicator it deviates from the auto-suggestion (Bonus); created/modified-by = Pat, server-derived timestamp; tenant_id = acme. |
| 5 | Override a NON-auto (manually-created) recommendation's amount | Same rule: an edit that deviates an amount/type/grade requires a justification; blank -> 400. |

## 6. Postconditions
- Emp C's recommendation is an Increment 5% with a recorded justification; no override was ever accepted without justification. Tenant-scoped to acme.
